proposals: PNGRB should publish a register of all applications under the 2025 LNG Terminal Registration Regulations, listing applicant, location, capacity, structure type (onshore, FSRU or gravity-based) and status, so projects like KGLNG's Kakinada terminal can be followed without relying on company press material.

PNGRB should issue a written clarification of how gravity-based structures are classified under its T4S and registration regulations, so the unconfirmed claim that GBS has been brought under FPSO definitions can be settled from primary text rather than repeated or rebutted by searching.

PNGRB should publish a summary of every Quantitative Risk Analysis it approves for terminal designs that depart from the T4S baseline, so the pathway for novel designs such as a GBS terminal, or any future jettyless transfer system, is documented case by case.

PNGRB should publish, terminal by terminal, how much regasification capacity is contracted and how much is available to other shippers, so the effect of dropping the common-carrier capacity-reservation requirement in May 2025 can be monitored.
